import math
F=0.001 # N
R=0.01 # m fingertip radius
mu=0.145e6 # Pa neo-Hookean from GelSight
E=3*mu
nu=0.5
Estar=E/(1-nu**2)
a=(3*F*R/(4*Estar))**(1/3)
p=F/(math.pi*a**2)
print(f"E={E/1e6:.3f} MPa Estar={Estar/1e6:.3f} MPa a={a*1e3:.3f} mm p={p/1e3:.3f} kPa")
# check Shore A10 estimate
for ShoreA in [5,10,20]:
    E2=math.exp(ShoreA*0.0235-0.6403)*1e6
    print(ShoreA, E2/1e6)
